html:
Independent Jeweler Marketing Leads

CaratBase sends leads to independent jewelers, estate buyers, and appraisers. The first 3 leads are free, then $40 per accepted lead. A Pro website widget is optional at $12/month.

What you get

  • First 3 leads free
  • $40 per accepted lead
  • Optional Pro website widget, $12/month

Why CaratBase

Leads come from people looking to sell gold, get an appraisal, or buy an engagement ring. CaratBase is starting in Atlanta, with other metros planned.

FAQ

How do I get started with CaratBase? Visit caratbase.com. The first 3 leads are free, then each accepted lead costs $40.

What is the Pro website widget? An optional $12/month widget for your website. Free widgets are also available on the widgets page.

Next Step

Learn more at caratbase.com.
